topics.title: Hubert
topics.intro: From #109 (merged 2026-10-29). You answered HB-1 to HB-7 in chat on 2026-10-29; they're in the settled list below. One follow-up from your question about the web.

questions.q: May Hubert bring a sale or listing he finds on the web into the report?
questions.context:
Why the rule exists. You asked: isn't pulling sales and prices the point of web search? The rule today is that a price never goes into the report straight from a web page. Every number in the estimate and the email has to trace to a comp the agent picked and the tool read itself (StreetEasy's page or export), with its photos and facts. A page Hubert skims can be stale, a different unit, or an ask rather than a sale, and from there it would reach a client. StreetEasy also blocks plain fetches, so his search can't read it reliably anyway.

What would work. Hubert finds a candidate on the web, then adds it as a comp through its StreetEasy link, so it goes through the same read and checks as a pasted link and shows on his trail. The agent still tiers it. This is item 5 in the Hubert plan.
options: Yes, through its StreetEasy link: same read and checks, on the trail
Yes, and let him type a web price in as a fact
unverified numbers can reach the client
No, the web stays for context only

questions.context:
What this is about. You want Claude sessions to see what happens in production (NW-090). The rule today is that sessions never connect to the production database.

questions.context: After one real sign-in on production: Netlify → Logs → Functions → the identity gate. Copy one line (it shows a bucket, never an address) into a comment on #110. It sizes the gate's limits, which are guesses for now.

questions.q: Tell us what came of the Noble sit-down
questions.context: TD-9 is done, but what came of it isn't recorded: the glossary's questions, the floor and distance thresholds, the differences approach. A line in the note or a dev note is enough.

questions.q: After the release: set the inspection API's four variables in Netlify
questions.context: Once #115 (sessions read production safely) is merged and released: in Netlify, Production context only, set CR_INSPECT_KEY and CR_TEST_KEY (each at least 32 characters, different from each other), CR_TEST_USER_EMAIL (an @test.invalid address) and CR_EVAL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Then put the first two in the Casa cloud environment. Until then the endpoint refuses every request. Never paste a key into a chat.
